title: Sync Campminder families into HubSpot without duplicates

facts: Residential summer camp. Campminder is the camper and family database; HubSpot is used for lead cultivation and marketing. The two do not communicate today.
Asks: meet the office manager, investigate Campminder API options, recommend the simplest reliable connection, implement and test, document and train staff.
Qualifications named: HubSpot integrations, REST APIs, Zapier, Make or similar, CRM data sync and duplicate prevention.
No contact name in the post. Personalization omitted (U-006 fallback: your team).

scenes.title: Follow one family update from Campminder into HubSpot.
scenes.caption: The sync looks for the family in HubSpot before it writes anything.
scenes.beat: When {{family.parent}} updates her family's details in Campminder, Make reads the full family record, then searches HubSpot by her email. She's already a contact from an earlier inquiry, so the sync updates that contact instead of creating a second one.
details: The search checks email first, then the Campminder ID saved on the HubSpot contact.
Two possible matches go to a review task for your office manager instead of guessing.
Whether Make hears about changes right away or checks on a schedule depends on what Campminder's API allows. I confirm that in discovery.

scenes.title: See which Campminder fields land on which HubSpot properties.
scenes.caption: Campminder stays the source for family details, and HubSpot keeps its own marketing history.
scenes.beat: Here's the field map for this family. On the left is what Campminder holds for {{family.parent}}. On the right is her HubSpot contact after the sync: the phone number, camper, session and Campminder ID come over, and her lifecycle stage moves to customer because {{family.camper}} is enrolled.
details: Each field moves one way only, so the two systems never overwrite each other.
Marketing emails, lead source and form history stay in HubSpot and are never written back to Campminder.
The final field list comes from the walkthrough with your office manager.
